paper_title: Axion search with quantum nondemolition detection of magnons
notes: Headline limit from abstract, Eq. (40) and conclusion: g_aee < 2.6e-6 at 95% CL for 33.117 ueV < ma < 33.130 ueV, a flat limit over the stated mass range (two points). The paper's g_aee is the dimensionless pseudoscalar axion-electron coupling (L = -i g_aee a psibar gamma5 psi, Eq. 2), equivalent on-shell to the canonical derivative-coupling g_ae, so no conversion applied. Paper already assumes rho_DM = 0.45 GeV/cm^3 and v_tot = 220 km/s, so no density rescaling needed. Confirmed against the vector 'This work' curve in Fig. 4 (limit.pdf in the e-print): a vertical exclusion spike at m = 3.31e-5 eV with lower edge at g = 2.67e-6. Conservative scenario chosen (minimum sin(theta) = 0.097 over the 4-hour run); Appendix A gives an alternative averaged-angle limit g_aee < 1.6e-7, which is not the headline result.
